provenance.scope: All 324 scans of the printed facsimile volume, in library order. Plates, printed transcriptions, preliminaries and blanks are separated by the measured rule below. No manuscript folio number is inferred, and the edition's plate numbering is kept apart from the codex's foliation.
provenance.page_kind_basis: Measured from the page itself and calibrated against pages read as images: a printed transcription or preliminary page is light with sparse dark type, a heliographic plate is darker and broader in tone, and a near uniform page is blank. The library page label is kept verbatim beside each decision.
provenance.label_scope: The library's own page label is kept verbatim as printed_header. It sits on plates and on their printed transcription pages alike, so it names the folio the page belongs to and is not an identification of the image as that folio.
